description:
Read stored ad spend and Plainrouter-earned conversions by channel, with cost per earned conversion by currency. Meta claims are shown separately from earned conversions. Spend and conversion dates are aligned; touch time does not move spend between days.
basis_note explains how the two counts differ.

conversion_kind.description: One conversion stage to count. Trial starts are reported separately from subscriptions.

from.description: Inclusive beginning of the conversion window. Defaults to 30 days before the end time.

level.description: Channel dimension used for per-channel rows. The broadest level, platform, is the default.

lookback.description: Maximum time between a touch and conversion, in days.

model.description: Journey credit model used for earned conversions.

to.description: Inclusive end of the conversion window. Defaults to the current time.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID returned by list_workspaces. Required when this credential reaches multiple workspaces.

name: get_cac_by_channel
title: Get cost per earned conversion by channel
